hookLine: Two bills came to one house. Pay or face termination. Mary Craft telephoned after a final notice and said she had paid a bill.

_notes.script: episodes/_planning/EP64_memphis_script.en.v002.md is the confirmed script. It was CUT on 2026-08-06 after the real narration master measured over the ceiling; do not restore anything from an earlier revision.
_notes.runtime: MEASURED, not modelled: the ffprobed ElevenLabs master gives 1915.1s for 5105 narration words, inside the contract band [1620,1920]. The scripts' own 176 words-per-finished-minute model runs 8-10 percent optimistic and is what put two films on this slate over the ceiling. Re-ffprobe after any script edit and check against 1920 before committing anything downstream.
_notes.voice: Pinned in the gen_narration_case.py registry and recorded in 06_audio/voice_plan.v001.json: voice nPczCjzI2devNBz1zQrb, model eleven_multilingual_v2, stability 0.35, similarity_boost 0.80. Do not change them: they are what makes these four episodes comparable to each other.
_notes.figures: 101 beats from EP64_memphis_beats.v002.json. USE v002, NOT v001. v001 carried non-verbatim quotations, wrong attributions and, on two episodes, a kind the builder rejects outright, and it spent the slot at figures[-1] -- which build_figures overwrites with the AI-disclosure card -- on the film's closing line.
_notes.people_plates: 10 declared in episode_spec as people_plates. They are named with this episode's prefix, not P###; check_episode_inputs reads the declared list.
_notes.mandatory_stills: episode_spec declares 215. The THUMB plates are deliberately excluded: a thumbnail is packaging, not a cut, and check_spec_satisfied fails any declared still that is in no cut.
_notes.assets: BLOCKER: only 16 archive clips survived visual QC against a floor near 146 for a film this long, and there are no motion clips at all. greene solved the same problem with 122 i2v clips in remotion/public/greene/motion; the tool that made them is not in this repository. The asset_manifest this config points at cannot be built until that pool exists.
_notes.shotlist: Do not hand-write one. It was retired at EP38. scripts/build_case_film_generic.py --config <this file> generates it.
